data.exact_reserve_text:
The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 3.5m (2017: favourable development of GBP 14.6m); this comprises releases of GBP 1.9m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 1.5m in respect of total Reinsurance business.

In addition to the favourable development reported above, the Syndicate result has also benefited from the resolution of a dispute between Newline Corporate Name Limited and a third party administrator, in respect of a number of historic binding authority agreements with the Syndicate. This has resulted in the return of certain claims paid under these binding authority agreements and legal costs totalling GBP 11.75m.

prior_year_events.event_name: dispute with a third party administrator over historic binding authority agreements
prior_year_events.impact_description: Return of certain claims paid under binding authority agreements and legal costs totalling GBP 11.75m benefiting the Syndicate result (favourable impact on reserves)

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding decreased materially on prior underwriting years with an estimated gross favourable development of approximately GBP 22.7m driven by reserve releases across older underwriting years (2011-2016). The movement note reports a net favourable development of GBP 3.5m after reinsurance recoveries, and the result was further assisted by a dispute resolution that returned certain claims and legal costs totalling GBP 11.75m. The gross release (from the claims development triangle) is significantly larger than the net release reported, reflecting material reinsurance recoveries.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 3.5m (2017: favourable development of GBP 14.6m); this comprises releases of GBP 1.9m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 1.5m in respect of total Reinsurance business.
This has resulted in the return of certain claims paid under these binding authority agreements and legal costs totalling GBP 11.75m.
data.data_quality_notes: The movement-in-prior-years note reports only a NET favourable development (GBP 3.5m) 'net of reinsurance recoveries'. A gross prior-year movement was not provided in that note, so the gross prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross ultimate estimates by underwriting year). The triangle calculation yields a gross release of c. GBP 22.744m. The difference between gross (-22.744m) and reported net (-3.5m) implies significant reinsurance recoveries (~GBP 19.2m). Amounts quoted in the movement note (releases of GBP 1.9m and GBP 1.5m) are presented in the note in the context of the NET statement and so may be net figures; confidence for LOB-level amounts is lower for that reason.
